nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) _balances holding every account token balance.
Private nested mapping _allowances[owner][spender] storing approved spending limits.
Private uint256 _totalSupply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Private mapping(address => bool) antiBotList used as a blacklist: any listed recipient is blocked inside _transfer.
Private address _owner of the Ownable base contract, controls every onlyOwner function.
Private uint8 _decimals, set to 18 at construction.
Constructor of BohemianBulldogs: sets name/symbol via ERC20 and mints 1e15*1e18 tokens to the deployer.
Internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount): increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Internal _transfer(sender, recipient, amount): performs balance bookkeeping and enforces the antiBotList blacklist on the recipient.
Public transfer(recipient, amount) forwarding to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Public transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount): moves tokens and decreases the caller allowance.
Public approve(spender, amount) writing the caller allowance through _approve.
Owner-only public mint(amount) that creates new tokens for msg.sender, unbounded inflation power.
Owner-only addOrRemoveFromBotList(addr, isAdd) writing the antiBotList blacklist mapping.
Owner-only transferOwnership(newOwner) that hands the contract ownership to another address.
onlyOwner modifier: requires _owner == _msgSender(), the sole access-control gate of the contract.
Public increaseAllowance(spender, addedValue) adding to the caller's allowance.
Public decreaseAllowance(spender, subtractedValue) subtracting from the caller's allowance.
Internal _approve(owner, spender, amount) writing _allowances and emitting Approval.
msg.sender, the caller identity used for ownership checks, minting and as the implicit transfer sender.
Mint of the whole initial supply (1e15*1e18) to the deployer inside the constructor, concentrating all tokens in one address.
require(!antiBotList[recipient]) inside _transfer: an owner-controlled blacklist that can block any recipient, a classic honeypot vector.
Unrestricted owner write path to antiBotList through addOrRemoveFromBotList, allowing arbitrary account freezing.
recipient argument of transfer(address,uint256).
amount argument of transfer(address,uint256).
sender argument of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
recipient argument of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
amount argument of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
spender argument of approve(address,uint256).
amount argument of approve(address,uint256).
amount argument of the owner-only mint(uint256).
addr argument of addOrRemoveFromBotList(address,bool) that is blacklisted or un-blacklisted.
isAdd argument of addOrRemoveFromBotList(address,bool) toggling the blacklist flag.
account argument of the internal _mint(address,uint256).
amount argument of the internal _mint(address,uint256).
newOwner argument of transferOwnership(address).
spender argument of increaseAllowance(address,uint256).
addedValue argument of increaseAllowance(address,uint256).
spender argument of decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).
subtractedValue argument of decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).

edges.reason: Constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender, tying the initial distribution to the deployer address.
The BohemianBulldogs constructor executes the initial-supply mint operation.
The initial mint credits _balances[deployer] with 1e15*1e18 tokens.
The initial mint increases _totalSupply by the full initial amount.
_mint account parameter is used to compute _totalSupply and balance updates.
_mint amount parameter flows into _totalSupply.add(amount).
Owner-only mint() calls the internal _mint to create new tokens.
mint() is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting inflation to the contract owner.
mint amount parameter is passed through to _mint for msg.sender.
mint mints the new tokens directly to msg.sender when the owner calls it.
transfer recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
transfer amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of the balance deduction.
Public transfer delegates all balance logic to internal _transfer.
_transfer reads and writes _balances for sender and recipient with SafeMath sub/add.
_transfer executes the antiBotList recipient check before moving balances.
The antiBotList mapping is read by the blacklist check inside _transfer.
transferFrom sender parameter is used as the debited account.
transferFrom recipient parameter is used as the credited account.
transferFrom amount parameter flows into _transfer and into the allowance subtraction.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() for the allowance lookup and decrement.
transferFrom calls _transfer to move the tokens.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the caller allowance.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][msg.sender] before subtracting the amount.
approve spender parameter is written into the allowance entry.
approve amount parameter becomes the new allowance value.
approve delegates the allowance write to internal _approve.
addOrRemoveFromBotList addr parameter determines which account is added to the blacklist.
addOrRemoveFromBotList isAdd parameter controls the boolean written to antiBotList.
addOrRemoveFromBotList is guarded by onlyOwner, so only the owner can freeze accounts.
The function body performs the unchecked (owner-trusted) blacklist mutation operation.
The blacklist mutation writes directly into the antiBotList state mapping.
transferOwnership newOwner parameter is forwarded to _transferOwnership.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner.
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable, transferring all privileged power.
onlyOwner compares the stored _owner against msg.sender to authorize privileged calls.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable as the reference for the authorization check.
increaseAllowance spender parameter is the allowance target.
increaseAllowance addedValue parameter is added to the current allowance.
increaseAllowance reads and updates the caller-spender allowance entry.
increaseAllowance finalizes the new allowance through _approve.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance spender parameter is the allowance target.
decreaseAllowance subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
decreaseAllowance reads and updates the caller-spender allowance entry.
decreaseAllowance finalizes the reduced allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
_approve writes the amount into _allowances[owner][spender].

normalization_plan.reason: transfer recipient is only meaningful as the destination argument of the transfer function.
transfer amount is only used inside the transfer function body.
transferFrom sender only exists as a parameter of transferFrom.
transferFrom recipient only exists as a parameter of transferFrom.
transferFrom amount only exists as a parameter of transferFrom.
approve spender is consumed solely by the approve function.
approve amount is consumed solely by the approve function.
mint amount is consumed solely by the owner-only mint function.
addOrRemoveFromBotList addr feeds the blacklist entry written in that function.
addOrRemoveFromBotList isAdd is the boolean written to the blacklist mapping.
_mint account is consumed directly by the internal _mint implementation.
_mint amount is consumed directly by the internal _mint implementation.
transferOwnership newOwner is consumed solely by the transferOwnership function.
increaseAllowance spender is consumed solely by increaseAllowance.
increaseAllowance addedValue is consumed solely by increaseAllowance.
decreaseAllowance spender is consumed solely by decreaseAllowance.
decreaseAllowance subtractedValue is consumed solely by decreaseAllowance.
